Read actual color/background/border and geometry samples associated with the selected screenshots; compare them with the unchanged role variables and compiled-rule evidence. Stop/purge only this owned verification run.

limitations: Appearance-preserving refactor of existing styles. This compares the specified genuine revisions and selected observed paths, with no claim of global pixel identity, exhaustive UI coverage or speed improvement.

Native recordings retain their existing frame cadence without editorial speed changes. Recorder lead-in/hold behavior and any capture misses are retained per original source. Selected excerpts are labelled; all selected complete originals remain downloadable.
Full viewport context precedes labelled detail crops. Held PNGs are labelled as stills in captions and provenance; no recorded motion is implied.
No model message, real provider credentials, paid API/resource, real webhook delivery or automation execution was used. Any genuine unconfigured-model or public-webhook warning is preserved.
All five built-in themes have representative automation form samples; this does not claim every theme/state/viewport combination.
Nine of14 full-class rules were observed live. The otherfive are compiled-CSS proof only; no runtime coverage is claimed for them.
Full expanded Entrypoint/setup fields are not paired settled live proof; early desktop stills are excluded. The native transition and phone-visible Custom Python portion remain.

Live paths cover create/setup form states and named samples recorded in the receipts. Compiled14-rule equivalence and67 existing behavior tests are separate regression proof, not invented runtime coverage.
